<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

Adds a new Prometheus counter metric `kueue_admission_cycle_preemption_skips_total` with `cluster_queue`, `reason`, and `replica_role` labels. Two skip reason constants are defined. A `recordSkippedPreemption` helper in the scheduler wires the counter into existing preemption-skip paths. Unit, fairness-share, concurrent-admission, and e2e tests are updated, along with English and Chinese metrics documentation.

## Changes

**Preemption Skips Counter Metric**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Counter metric definition and lifecycle** <br> `pkg/metrics/metrics.go` | Declares `PreemptionSkipReasonOverlappingTargets` and `PreemptionSkipReasonNoLongerFits` constants, declares `AdmissionCyclePreemptionSkipsTotal` counter vec, initializes it in `InitMetricVectors`, clears it in `ClearClusterQueueMetrics`, registers it in `Register`, and adds the `ReportAdmissionCyclePreemptionSkipTotal` reporting helper. |
| **Scheduler recordSkippedPreemption wiring** <br> `pkg/scheduler/scheduler.go` | Adds `Scheduler.recordSkippedPreemption` helper that increments the per-cycle `skipped` map and calls `ReportAdmissionCyclePreemptionSkipTotal`. Updates the two `processEntry` preemption-skip call sites (overlapping targets and no-longer-fits paths) to use the new helper with the appropriate reason constant. |
| **Test coverage, e2e assertion, and documentation** <br> `pkg/scheduler/scheduler_test.go`, `pkg/scheduler/scheduler_fs_test.go`, `pkg/scheduler/scheduler_concurrent_admission_test.go`, `test/e2e/singlecluster/baseline/metrics_test.go`, `site/content/en/docs/reference/metrics.md`, `site/content/zh-CN/docs/reference/metrics.md` | Unit tests reset `AdmissionCyclePreemptionSkipsTotal` before each sub-run and assert summed skip totals via the `skipsTotalForCQ` helper. The e2e metrics test adds the new counter to availability and deletion assertions. English and Chinese metrics docs add the new counter row. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes

> `OverlappingTargets`, `NoLongerFits`,  
> Each skip reason carefully commits.  
> The metrics doc shines, East and West—

</details>
